d: Hevi injiniyring korporeshan (echaeesi) ko bachane ki laraee ab nae mor par pahunchti dikh rahi hai. kanpni ki aarthik badhali, karmachariyon ke lanbe samay se bakaya vetan aur ensielti ki karravaee ke bich majdur sangathnon ne prabandhan ke khilaph morcha khol diya hai. echaeesi mukhyalay ke bahar lagatar virodh pradarshan kar rahe karmachariyon ne ab aandolan ko charanbaddh tarike se aage barhane ki taiyari ki hai.
